newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Client demand, inactive T-bill buying press rouble.
newsitem.headline: Client demand, inactive T-bill buying press rouble.

text.p: The rouble eased on Thursday on bank client demand and fewer funds seeking government securities, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Feb 20 midday Feb 20 early Feb 19 close
"The dollar is going up on demand from clients and banks closing their positions," a Bank Stolichny dealer said.
The rouble was likely to ease later on Thursday as the T-bill market becomes more subdued following Wednesday's auctions, dealers said.
"The T-bill market is not active at the moment, and it may mean banks do have roubles (for later dollar investing)," one said.
On Wednesday, February 19, the central bank auctioned four trillion roubles of six-month paper and 7.5 trillion roubles of 10-month bills.
